card: P2 job template — writer allowlist so a non-CAD Factory job can run on a named FIPS and refuse without one
missionPremise: P2-JURIS persist is blocked because the only Factory writer that can run on a named FIPS is CAD. A CAD-only allowlist is the defect. Sources: _dispatches/2026-08-30_p2-job_dispatch.md; _inbox/2026-08-30_p2_job_mission.md; OPS-19 F-01; P2-JURIS close leave_behind.
completionPredicate: Uncommitted Factory diff plus this card's CP1/CP2/close. Missing county refuses COUNTY_REQUIRED. Named county plus a run row is accepted as a dry plan with persistExecuted false. Laptop --apply refuses LAPTOP_WRITE_FROZEN before any connection. Writer allowlist names containment persist, F-11 setback, and easement with no live REST. PERSIST_SPEC shape is consumed and not written. No commit, push, deploy, Cloud Run job start, 0005 apply, or persist.
scopeBasis: hauska-factory this worktree only. p1-controls / gate8 / p2-juris trees are read by path, never written. 0005 is not applied. Persist UPDATE is not this card. Conformant.mjs 48021 default is P1-FACTORY's card and is not edited here.

adversarial.claim: factory-conformant plus requireCountyFips is enough for P2-JURIS persist
adversarial.finding: origin/main 7f41f52 factory-conformant still defaults county to BASTROP 48021 and is a CAD writer. A non-CAD persist of city_manifest.payload.all_county_fips has no job, no allowlist entry, and no dry-plan path. Mechanism: the only Band-1 apply path is CAD.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: reuse factory-conformant --county= for persist; rejected because that job writes landing_cad_property through stage E, not city_manifest

adversarial.claim: the writer allowlist can be CAD plus a comment that other jobs will be added later
adversarial.finding: the card names a CAD-only allowlist as the defect. A comment is not an allowlist entry. Containment persist, F-11 setback, and easement with no live REST must be named now so a non-CAD job can be required.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: ship CAD-only and extend later; rejected because persist waits on this template

adversarial.claim: copying sql/p2-juris/03 into this tree and running it is consuming PERSIST_SPEC
adversarial.finding: 03 is SELECT-only in the p2-juris tree. Persist is a later Factory job that writes city_manifest.payload from the spatial array. This card consumes the result-set shape (place_fips, name, parent_county_fips, all_county_fips) and refuses execute.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: copy the SQL and apply; rejected because persist is not this card and the other tree is not opened for write

countyRefuse.what: parseP2JurisFlags uses requireCountyFips(flagValue(argv, '--county')). Both --county= and --county forms. Never default 48021.
countyRefuse.fails: COUNTY_REQUIRED / COUNTY_UNKNOWN before any store write
countyRefuse.bypasses: a caller that passes {flags:{county:'48021'}} explicitly (named, not defaulted)

runRowFirst.what: requireRunRow before any write. Dry plan accepts a named county plus an existing run row. Apply on Cloud Run would startRun first. Persist UPDATE is not called.
runRowFirst.bypasses: a raw SQL UPDATE on city_manifest (nothing in this repo issues one)

writerAllowlist.what: WRITER_JOBS names containment-persist, f11-setback, easement-no-live-rest, and factory-conformant. assertWriterAllowlistNotCadOnly fails a CAD-only map. requireWriterJob refuses an unnamed job. easement liveRest must be false.
writerAllowlist.triggers: every p2-juris invocation and the suite
writerAllowlist.bypasses: a job that never calls requireWriterJob

persistSpec.what: consumePersistSpec accepts the 03 PERSIST_SPEC columns only. planCountyPersist filters by named FIPS. executeContainmentPersist always refuses PERSIST_NOT_THIS_CARD.

laptopFreeze.what: --apply and FACTORY_CLOUD !== '1' throws LAPTOP_WRITE_FROZEN before connectFn.
laptopFreeze.bypasses: FACTORY_CLOUD=1 on a laptop (same as other Factory writers)

p1Helpers.what: origin/main already has requireCountyFips. collect-complete.mjs is copied from p1-controls (uncommitted there). conformant.mjs is not edited.
p1Helpers.triggers: import; CAD writers on the P1 card
p1Helpers.fails: COLLECT_INCOMPLETE when the copied gate is called with no ledger row
p1Helpers.bypasses: this stub is not CAD and does not call requireCollectComplete

constraintsHonored: no commit, push, deploy, Cloud Run job start, 0005 apply, persist, connection URL print
no write to p1-controls, gate8, or p2-juris trees
